indicators.label: FPAR, cropland
indicators.caveat: The FPAR record is not a single stable instrument -- read a raw FPAR trend as possible sensor history or land-use change, not as climate, unless SPI-3 agrees.

indicators.label: Soil moisture (gapfilled), cropland
indicators.caveat: Not usable as a trend. ASAP gapfills this series only up to dekad 2023-12-21 and continues with un-gapfilled soil moisture after it; the series steps down right at that cutover (mean z -0.58 after vs +0.06 before), so its apparent decline mixes a methodology change with any real signal.
